Atlas Services Foundations
Service 01 / 04 · Foundations

Footings, stems, mat slabs.

The part nobody sees, and the part everything above it depends on. Atlas has poured more than a thousand foundations across the Bay Area — hillside, infill, rebuild, commercial. We read the soils report, coordinate rebar and waterproofing, and hand the next trade a clean, inspected surface on the day we said.

Bid this scope

Scope

Strip and spread footings, stem walls, grade beams, mat slabs, pier and pile caps, deep pours and stepped hillside systems. We handle formwork, rebar placement, embeds, waterproofing coordination, and pour — soup to nuts, one crew.

Sites we do well

Hillside. Crowded infill. Tight urban lots with pump-only access. Hand-dug underpinning on historic remodels. Commercial slabs where the MEP sleeves are dense and the embed coordination matters.

How we're priced

Flat-rate bid against the drawings, broken out by line. Footings, stems, and slabs are separately priced so change orders stay clean. Most residential foundations fall between $18K and $80K; commercial scope is sized against yardage.

Typical mix3,000–5,000 psi
Reinforcement#4 – #6
InspectionsFooting · pre-pour · final
Cylinder breaks4 per 50 cy
Bid turnaround3–5 days
Lead time2–4 weeks

02What's included

01 /

Site Prep

Excavation coordination, forms layout, moisture barrier, compacted subgrade verified before rebar.

02 /

Rebar & Embeds

Rebar placed to engineer's spec. Hold-downs, anchor bolts, MEP sleeves and embeds coordinated in-house.

03 /

Formwork

Plywood-ply or steel-ply forms, depending on finish. Engineered ties for pours over 4 feet.

04 /

Pour

5:30 start, pump or chute depending on access, full consolidation, screed and float as scope requires.

05 /

Waterproofing

Handoff coordination with membrane sub. Keyways, drainboards, weep systems installed as needed.

06 /

Demob

Form ties pulled, patches done, spoils hauled, inspection scheduled. Next trade gets a ready site.
